summary.en: The strip look: one strip of real film on a light box (or an editing bench), black base and sprocket holes, intertitles set in the strip, one grease-pencil accent for the pick.
summary.zh: strip 的样式：灯箱（或剪辑台）上一条真实胶片，黑色片基和齿孔，字幕卡做成胶片里的画格，唯一的强调色是圈选用的蜡笔。

fits: Films about films, renders, frames and versions: a video tool, a model that makes video, a release of several films.
notFor: Products with no frames to show; dashboards and documents.

intent.en: Show the work as physical film: real frames you can count, measure and pick by hand.
intent.zh: 把作品当成实体胶片展示：一格一格真实画面，可以数、可以量、可以亲手圈选。

content.en: Real frames (16:9, ≥ 832 × 468 source px), one row strip per film, 2–5 short intertitles (≤ 3 words / 8 字).
content.zh: 真实画格（16:9，源像素 ≥ 832 × 468），每支片一条缩略条，2–5 张短字幕卡（≤ 3 词 / 8 字）。

fits.zh: 关于影片、渲染、画格与版本的片子：视频工具、做视频的模型、多支片的发布。

notFor.zh: 没有画面可展示的产品；仪表盘与文档。

en: The pencil must differ from every colour in the picked cell by ΔE00 ≥ 20; take the blue preset for red frames.
Frames are only scaled and veiled; never recolour them.
zh: 蜡笔色与被圈画格里的颜色 ΔE00 ≥ 20；红色画格换蓝笔配色。
画格只缩放和加遮罩，不重新上色。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
